description: A shell script for upgrading Kubernetes clusters on Google Cloud Engine (GCE), including master and node upgrades, environment setup, and CoreDNS configuration updates.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information and fetches current Kubernetes release versions.

methods.name: print-node-version-info
methods.description: Prints OS and Kubelet versions for nodes.

methods.name: upgrade-master
methods.description: Performs upgrade of the Kubernetes master node.

methods.name: upgrade-master-env
methods.description: Upgrades environment variables for the master node.

methods.name: wait-for-master
methods.description: Waits until the new master responds to API requests.

methods.name: prepare-upgrade
methods.description: Prepares the cluster for upgrade, setting up necessary variables and environment.

methods.name: get-node-env
methods.description: Retrieves kube-env metadata from the first node.

methods.name: get-node-os
methods.description: Reads OS distribution info from a node.

methods.name: setup-base-image
methods.description: Ensures node base OS image matches existing nodes.

methods.name: prepare-node-upgrade
methods.description: Creates a new instance template for node upgrade.

methods.name: do-single-node-upgrade
methods.description: Upgrades a single node, including draining, recreating, and waiting for readiness.

methods.name: do-node-upgrade
methods.description: Performs parallel node upgrades across instance groups.

methods.name: update-coredns-config
methods.description: Updates CoreDNS configuration during cluster upgrade.
